versos.hebraico: וַֽיהוָ֛ה פָּקַ֥ד אֶת־שָׂרָ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמָ֑ר וַיַּ֧עַשׂ יְהוָ֛ה לְשָׂרָ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.
controles.kjv: And the Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR visitou Sara, como disse, e o SENHOR fez com Sara como havia falado.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּהַר֩ וַתֵּ֨לֶד שָׂרָ֧ה לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם בֵּ֖ן לִזְקֻנָ֑יו לַמּוֹעֵ֕ד אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
controles.kjv: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
controles.livre: E concebeu e deu à luz Sara a Abraão um filho em sua velhice, no tempo que Deus lhe havia dito.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶֽת־שֶׁם־בְּנ֧וֹ הַנּֽוֹלַד־ל֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־יָלְדָה־לּ֥וֹ שָׂרָ֖ה יִצְחָֽק׃

controles.web: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
controles.kjv: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
controles.livre: E chamou Abraão o nome de seu filho que lhe nasceu, que lhe deu à luz Sara, Isaque.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤מָל אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת־יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔וֹ בֶּן־שְׁמֹנַ֖ת יָמִ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
controles.kjv: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
controles.livre: E circuncidou Abraão a seu filho Isaque de oito dias, como Deus lhe havia mandado.

versos.hebraico: וְאַבְרָהָ֖ם בֶּן־מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה בְּהִוָּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת יִצְחָ֥ק בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.
controles.kjv: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
controles.livre: E era Abraão de cem anos, quando lhe nasceu Isaque seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר שָׂרָ֔ה צְחֹ֕ק עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י אֱלֹהִ֑ים כָּל־הַשֹּׁמֵ֖עַ יִֽצְחַק־לִֽי׃

controles.web: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”
controles.kjv: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
controles.livre: Então disse Sara: Deus me fez rir, e qualquer um que o ouvir, se rirá comigo.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר מִ֤י מִלֵּל֙ לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם הֵינִ֥יקָה בָנִ֖ים שָׂרָ֑ה כִּֽי־יָלַ֥דְתִּי בֵ֖ן לִזְקֻנָֽיו׃

controles.web: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham, that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
controles.kjv: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
controles.livre: E acrescentou: Quem diria a Abraão que Sara havia de dar de mamar a filhos? pois que lhe dei um filho em sua velhice.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּגְדַּ֥ל הַיֶּ֖לֶד וַיִּגָּמַ֑ל וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אַבְרָהָם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֣ה גָד֔וֹל בְּי֖וֹם הִגָּמֵ֥ל אֶת־יִצְחָֽק׃

controles.web: The child grew, and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
controles.kjv: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
controles.livre: E cresceu o menino, e foi desmamado; e fez Abraão grande banquete no dia que foi desmamado Isaque.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֨רֶא שָׂרָ֜ה אֶֽת־בֶּן־הָגָ֧ר הַמִּצְרִ֛ית אֲשֶׁר־יָלְדָ֥ה לְאַבְרָהָ֖ם מְצַחֵֽק׃

controles.web: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
controles.kjv: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
controles.livre: E viu Sara ao filho de Agar a egípcia, o qual havia esta dado a Abraão, que o ridicularizava.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם גָּרֵ֛שׁ הָאָמָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את וְאֶת־בְּנָ֑הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִירַשׁ֙ בֶּן־הָאָמָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את עִם־בְּנִ֖י עִם־יִצְחָֽק׃

controles.web: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this handmaid and her son! For the son of this handmaid will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
controles.kjv: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
controles.livre: Portanto disse a Abraão: Expulsa a esta serva e a seu filho; que o filho desta serva não herdará com meu filho, com Isaque.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֧רַע הַדָּבָ֛ר מְאֹ֖ד בְּעֵינֵ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם עַ֖ל אוֹדֹ֥ת בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.
controles.kjv: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.
controles.livre: Este dito pareceu grave em grande maneira a Abraão por causa de seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֗ם אַל־יֵרַ֤ע בְּעֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ עַל־הַנַּ֣עַר וְעַל־אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֛יךָ שָׂרָ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹלָ֑הּ כִּ֣י בְיִצְחָ֔ק יִקָּרֵ֥א לְךָ֖ זָֽרַע׃

controles.web: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your handmaid. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For from Isaac will your seed be called.
controles.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
controles.livre: Então disse Deus a Abraão: Não te pareça grave por causa do jovem e de tua serva; em tudo o que te disser Sara, ouve sua voz, porque em Isaque será chamada tua descendência.

versos.hebraico: וְגַ֥ם אֶת־בֶּן־הָאָמָ֖ה לְג֣וֹי אֲשִׂימֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֥י זַרְעֲךָ֖ הֽוּא׃

controles.web: I will also make a nation of the son of the handmaid, because he is your seed.”
controles.kjv: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
controles.livre: E também do filho da serva farei nação, porque é descendência tua.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם אַבְרָהָ֣ם׀ בַּבֹּ֡קֶר וַיִּֽקַּֽח־לֶחֶם֩ וְחֵ֨מַת מַ֜יִם וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־הָ֠גָר שָׂ֧ם עַל־שִׁכְמָ֛הּ וְאֶת־הַיֶּ֖לֶד וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֶ֑הָ וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ וַתֵּ֔תַע בְּמִדְבַּ֖ר בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃

controles.web: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
controles.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer–sheba.
controles.livre: Então Abraão se levantou manhã muito cedo, e tomou pão, e um odre de água, e deu-o a Agar, pondo-o sobre seu ombro, e entregou-lhe o jovem, e despediu-a. E ela partiu, e andava errante pelo deserto de Berseba.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּכְל֥וּ הַמַּ֖יִם מִן־הַחֵ֑מֶת וַתַּשְׁלֵ֣ךְ אֶת־הַיֶּ֔לֶד תַּ֖חַת אַחַ֥ד הַשִּׂיחִֽם׃

controles.web: The water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
controles.kjv: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
controles.livre: E faltou a água do odre, e deitou ao jovem debaixo de uma árvore;

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּלֶךְ֩ וַתֵּ֨שֶׁב לָ֜הּ מִנֶּ֗גֶד הַרְחֵק֙ כִּמְטַחֲוֵ֣י קֶ֔שֶׁת כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֔ה אַל־אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּמ֣וֹת הַיָּ֑לֶד וַתֵּ֣שֶׁב מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַתִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת־קֹלָ֖הּ וַתֵּֽבְךְּ׃

controles.web: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
controles.kjv: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
controles.livre: E foi-se e sentou-se em frente, afastando-se como um tiro de arco; porque dizia: Não verei quando o jovem morrer: e sentou-se em frente, e levantou sua voz e chorou.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִים֮ אֶת־ק֣וֹל הַנַּעַר֒ וַיִּקְרָא֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ אֶל־הָגָר֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖הּ מַה־לָּ֣ךְ הָגָ֑ר אַל־תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֧ע אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶל־ק֥וֹל הַנַּ֖עַר בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּא־שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: God heard the voice of the boy.   The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What ails you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
controles.kjv: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
controles.livre: E ouviu Deus a voz do jovem; e o anjo de Deus chamou a Agar desde o céu, e lhe disse: Que tens, Agar? Não temas; porque Deus ouviu a voz do jovem onde está.

versos.hebraico: ק֚וּמִי שְׂאִ֣י אֶת־הַנַּ֔עַר וְהַחֲזִ֥יקִי אֶת־יָדֵ֖ךְ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־לְג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל אֲשִׂימֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him in your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”
controles.kjv: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
controles.livre: Levanta-te, ergue ao jovem, e pegue-o por tua mão, porque farei dele uma grande nação.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפְקַ֤ח אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־עֵינֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּ֖רֶא בְּאֵ֣ר מָ֑יִם וַתֵּ֜לֶךְ וַתְּמַלֵּ֤א אֶת־הַחֵ֨מֶת֙ מַ֔יִם וַתַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־הַנָּֽעַר׃

controles.web: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the bottle with water, and gave the boy drink.
controles.kjv: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
controles.livre: Então abriu Deus os olhos dela, e ela viu uma fonte de água; e foi, e encheu o odre de água, e deu de beber ao jovem.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֧י אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הַנַּ֖עַר וַיִּגְדָּ֑ל וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וַיְהִ֖י רֹבֶ֥ה קַשָּֽׁת׃

controles.web: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.
controles.kjv: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
controles.livre: E foi Deus com o jovem; e cresceu, e habitou no deserto, e foi atirador de arco.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר פָּארָ֑ן וַתִּֽקַּֽח־ל֥וֹ אִמּ֛וֹ אִשָּׁ֖ה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃פ

controles.web: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother took a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E habitou no deserto de Parã; e sua mãe lhe tomou mulher da terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וּפִיכֹל֙ שַׂר־צְבָא֔וֹ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עִמְּךָ֔ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
controles.livre: E aconteceu naquele mesmo tempo que falou Abimeleque, e Ficol, príncipe de seu exército, a Abraão dizendo: Deus é contigo em tudo quanto fazes.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּׁ֨בְעָה לִּ֤י בֵֽאלֹהִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה אִם־תִּשְׁקֹ֣ר לִ֔י וּלְנִינִ֖י וּלְנֶכְדִּ֑י כַּחֶ֜סֶד אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֤יתִי עִמְּךָ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה עִמָּדִ֔י וְעִם־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־גַּ֥רְתָּה בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”
controles.kjv: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
controles.livre: Agora, pois, jura-me aqui por Deus, que não tratarás com falsidade a mim, nem a meu filho, nem a meu neto; mas sim que conforme a bondade que eu fiz contigo, farás tu comigo e com a terra onde peregrinaste.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם אָנֹכִ֖י אִשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: Abraham said, “I will swear.”
controles.kjv: And Abraham said, I will swear.
controles.livre: E respondeu Abraão: Eu jurarei.

versos.hebraico: וְהוֹכִ֥חַ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ עַל־אֹדוֹת֙ בְּאֵ֣ר הַמַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּזְל֖וּ עַבְדֵ֥י אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃

controles.web: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
controles.kjv: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
controles.livre: E Abraão reclamou com Abimeleque por causa de um poço de água, que os servos de Abimeleque lhe haviam tirado.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי מִ֥י עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְגַם־אַתָּ֞ה לֹא־הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֗י וְגַ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בִּלְתִּ֥י הַיּֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, neither did I hear of it, until today.”
controles.kjv: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
controles.livre: E respondeu Abimeleque: Não sei quem tenha feito isto, nem tampouco tu me fizeste saber, nem eu o ouvi até hoje.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֤ח אַבְרָהָם֙ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לַאֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַיִּכְרְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם בְּרִֽית׃

controles.web: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.
controles.kjv: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
controles.livre: E tomou Abraão ovelhas e vacas, e deu a Abimeleque; e fizeram ambos aliança.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּצֵּ֣ב אַבְרָהָ֗ם אֶת־שֶׁ֛בַע כִּבְשֹׂ֥ת הַצֹּ֖אן לְבַדְּהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
controles.kjv: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
controles.livre: E pôs Abraão sete cordeiras do rebanho à parte.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֑ם מָ֣ה הֵ֗נָּה שֶׁ֤בַע כְּבָשֹׂת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִצַּ֖בְתָּ לְבַדָּֽנָה׃

controles.web: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves mean?”
controles.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
controles.livre: E disse Abimeleque a Abraão: Que significam essas sete cordeiras que puseste à parte?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֚י אֶת־שֶׁ֣בַע כְּבָשֹׂ֔ת תִּקַּ֖ח מִיָּדִ֑י בַּעֲבוּר֙ תִּֽהְיֶה־לִּ֣י לְעֵדָ֔ה כִּ֥י חָפַ֖רְתִּי אֶת־הַבְּאֵ֥ר הַזֹּֽאת׃

controles.web: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”
controles.kjv: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
controles.livre: E ele respondeu: Que estas sete cordeiras tomarás de minha mão, para que me sejam em testemunho de que eu cavei este poço.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֗ן קָרָ֛א לַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע כִּ֛י שָׁ֥ם נִשְׁבְּע֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore there.
controles.kjv: Wherefore he called that place Beer–sheba; because there they sware both of them.
controles.livre: Por isto chamou a aquele lugar Berseba; porque ali ambos juraram.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּכְרְת֥וּ בְרִ֖ית בִּבְאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיָּ֣קָם אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וּפִיכֹל֙ שַׂר־צְבָא֔וֹ וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

controles.web: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
controles.kjv: Thus they made a covenant at Beer–sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
controles.livre: Assim fizeram aliança em Berseba: e levantaram-se Abimeleque e Ficol, príncipe de seu exército, e se voltaram à terra dos filisteus.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּטַּ֥ע אֶ֖שֶׁל בִּבְאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיִּ֨קְרָא־שָׁ֔ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵ֥ל עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and called there on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.
controles.kjv: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.
controles.livre: E plantou Abraão um bosque em Berseba, e invocou ali o nome do SENHOR Deus eterno.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֧גָר אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃פ

controles.web: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
controles.kjv: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.
controles.livre: E morou Abraão na terra dos filisteus por muitos dias.
